t: What he told Hakim after giving him three times
a: إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ خَضِرَةٌ حُلْوَةٌ، فَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِطِيبِ نَفْسٍ بُورِكَ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِإِشْرَافِ نَفْسٍ لَمْ يُبَارَكْ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَكَانَ كَالَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلاَ يَشْبَعُ
p: Inna hādha-l-māla khaḍiratun ḥulwah. Fa-man akhadhahu bi-ṭībi nafsin būrika lahu fīh, wa man akhadhahu bi-ishrāfi nafsin lam yubārak lahu fīh, wa kāna ka-lladhī yaʾkulu wa lā yashbaʿ
m: This wealth is green and sweet. Whoever takes it with a contented heart is blessed in it. Whoever takes it with a craving heart is not blessed in it, and is like the one who eats and is not filled.
